title: Charity Bank — Green Loans
description: Loans from Charity Bank for charities and social enterprises funding energy efficiency, renewable generation and other environmental improvements to their buildings or operations. Repayable finance, not a grant.
source_note: Staged 2026-08-17. The only fund of 215 enumerated across 23 generic rows that clears the £5,000 floor AND has its own page distinct from its funder's umbrella.
